question: In a win-or-lose game, the winner gets 2 points whereas the loser gets 0. Six players $A,B,C,D,E$ and $F$ play each other in a preliminary round from which the top three players move to the final round. After each player has played four games, $A$ has 6 points, $B$ has 8 points and $C$ has 4 points. It is also known that $E$ won against $F$. In the next set of games $D,E$ and $F$ win their games against $A,B$ and $C$ respectively. If $A,B$ and $D$ move to the final round, the final scores of $E$ and $F$ are, respectively,
